column1: # Explanation script revision 4 with the code of spec 11 and spec 11.5, frozen a third time before the first boot of the
# C1 cycle (2026-11-19; plan/full_stage_results_20261116.md 26.5; plan/c1_closure_explain_rev4_spec_20261118.md 11.5;
# plan/c1_closure_evaluation_protocol_20261118.md 14.13; review records/closure-review-preboot-20261119).  It replaces
# records/closure-preboot-20261119/freeze.tsv (70bbf7f5..., kept unchanged) for the boots of the cycle, which replaced
# records/closure-explain-rev4-20261119/freeze.tsv (733feef7..., kept); the boot declaration boot/declaration3.tsv names
# it.  Source commit ef6d38f (the code of spec 11.5; nothing in these files changed after it).  Exit checks before this
# freeze, on these bytes, under the space guard: fixtures test_explain4.py 206/206 and test_explain_eval.py 116/116
# (out/freeze_fixtures.txt, out/freeze_eval_fixtures.txt; sha256 of every part the same before and after,
# out/freeze_sha_*.txt); with the same judge and reader (results 26.5): the 2026-11-16 regression (8 D1 branches x 45
# records, only the script identity differs), the static dry runs with the 16 branches (2 x 16 x 46 records, the same),
# the two runtime test dumps (the same), the four synthetic records explained again (the same but the label) and two
# with one loss line added (no-build-id: the same; after-stop: the loss rule of spec 11.5 item 1).  A change of the
# reader part only (the judge's sha256 the same, the diff kept) leaves a boot's standing; a change of the judgement part
# after a boot makes that boot a record seen before the rules (evaluation protocol 12 item 6).  The summary is not
# revised after a boot in this cycle (results 26.0 (자); protocol 14.0).  The falsifier and evaluation script and the
# expectation comparison write no record and are no input of Kairos.
# changed against 70bbf7f5: judge (spec 11.5 item 1: the loss kinds no-build-id and object-table, the found use's link
# reason by its cause), eval (11.5 item 3: revision 2), fixtures (11.5 items 1-2: 206 checks), eval_fixtures (11.5 item 3:
